setup: cd webserver/web && npm ci && npm run build
notes: Webserver (Go + Vite UI) and the Android app (Kotlin + gomobile vaultcore.aar). The macOS app needs Xcode and cannot build in the Linux sandbox. Node 22 comes from the sandbox image; ffmpeg is for video thumbnails. Android: .kunj/presets/android.sh installs the SDK into /opt/android-sdk and keeps Gradle's cache in /opt/gradle so the snapshot has it; on an arm64 host the NDK and aapt2 (x86_64-only) run through the Docker VM's x86_64 emulation, as do gomobile and gobind (built for amd64), so builds are slower than on the Mac. The android steps skip until android/ is on the default branch. Instrumented tests need an emulator with KVM and do not run here. gomobile must match golang.org/x/mobile in webserver/go.mod. Use test-short: the full webserver tests need FUSE.
